name: Smiley's game
source:
You wake up in a strange room surrounded by strangers. How did you get here? But more importantly, how do you get out of here? Can you survive Smiley's game?

[From [url=https://johanofkarlsson.itch.io/smileys-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个陌生的房间里醒来，周围都是陌生人。你是怎么到这里来的？但更重要的是，你如何离开这里？你能在史迈利的游戏中生存下来吗？

[来自[url=https://johanofkarlsson.itch.io/smileys-game]Itch.io[/url]]
